content:
The Clay Mathematics Institute is hosting a CMI HIMR summer school in Oxford (UK) on formalizing class field theory in Lean, being run by me and @Richard Hill . Details are here https://www.claymath.org/events/formalizing-class-field-theory/ .

One thing that perhaps isn't made clear; strong preference will be given to PhD students (and note that travel isn't covered, but everything else is). Apparently early post-docs will be considered but will be at the bottom of the pile, but don't even bother if you're a lecturer, and if you're an MSc student then you had better be a very strong candidate.

Any questions or comments? Please ask in the discussion thread for this topic.

The closing date for registration for this workshop is in just over 2 weeks so I thought I'd ping it again. It's targetted at PhD students and it's specifically not for tenured people but having talked to several post-docs/MSc students about this I would encourage such people to apply and we'll see what we can do.
